title: Projects
text:
Multimodal Co-Registration Pipeline
Automated registration of in vivo two-photon z-stacks → ex vivo light-sheet 3D volumes → ex vivo Xenium 2D spatial transcriptomics slices, with a Qt5 QC application. Cut registration time from ~3 hours (experienced user) to ~1 hour (novice).

Stack: Python, image registration, Qt5, Claude Code

title: Projects
text:
3D ROI Quality Classifier
LightGBM-based classifier (AUC > 0.95) on engineered intensity, morphology, shape, and context features, with a two-capsule inference/retraining architecture tracked in MLflow. Combined with the registration pipeline, improved downstream accuracy by ~15%.

Stack: Python, LightGBM, MLflow, human-in-the-loop retraining

title: About
text:
I’m a computational imaging scientist working at the intersection of microscopy, spatial transcriptomics, and machine learning. My background is in neuroscience imaging (in vivo two-photon, ex vivo light-sheet), and I’m building toward roles in imaging ML / computational biology / computational pathology at biotech and AI-for-bio companies.
Recent focus areas:

Multimodal image registration across imaging modalities and scales
ML-based quality control for 3D segmentation/ROI data (LightGBM, human-in-the-loop retraining, MLflow)
Agentic-AI-assisted pipeline development (Claude Code)
Closing gaps toward computational pathology: whole-slide image tooling, foundation-model embeddings, MIL
